subject: Placeholder environment block textures for the lab, facility and prison levels: observation and lab windows, specimen tanks, containment tube, bay, hazard and blast doors, cell bars and gate, lockers, ceiling light, terminal, lab tile wall, yellow stairs, ladder and railing, drain culvert.
visual_approach: Programmer pixel art: hard edges, no antialiasing, steel frames with 1 px highlight / shade bevels and dark seams; cool cyan lab light, amber and red accents; colours from the project's shared palette.

generation_settings.palette: 85 hex constants: the 41 of tools/blocks_placeholder.py followed by 44 in tools/blocks_themes/common.py, all from the project's shared palette (not in the repository)

creative_seed.note: No generator seed. The script uses random.Random with fixed seeds (per-call seeds in the helpers, 101-144 in this theme's tiles) for small details such as grime streaks, bubbles and spots. Every rebuild is identical.

style_inheritance: follows blocks-placeholder.png (same tile size, bevel and seam rules, palette extended from its palette)

post_analysis.provenance: Post-generation subagent visual analysis; not part of the original generation prompt.
post_analysis.subject: A 6x3 atlas of 64 px pixel-art tiles for a sci-fi lab / facility / prison environment: windows, specimen tanks, doors, bars, lockers, a light, a terminal, wall tiles, stairs, ladder, railing and a drain.
post_analysis.composition: Flat grid of 18 square tiles, six columns by three rows, no gaps. Each tile is a front-on side view. Most are a single object centred on a dark grey wall; some fill the tile edge to edge (windows, bars, tile wall, railing, ceiling light).
post_analysis.environment: Industrial sci-fi laboratory and detention facility. Dark steel wall backgrounds with rivets, hazard striping, glass, water and caged openings.
post_analysis.colors: Dark charcoal grey base. Accents: cyan and pale blue (water, glass, screens, tile wall), amber / orange (hazard stripes, lit rooms, locker suit), red (lights, tube, door chevrons), yellow (rails, ladder, stairs handrail), olive green (specimen tanks).
post_analysis.materials: Brushed and riveted dark steel, glass with highlights, translucent coloured liquid, pale glazed tiles with grout, painted hazard stripes, vertical metal bars, grey concrete bricks, falling water.
post_analysis.lighting: Lit from within by coloured sources: cyan tank and window glow, amber room glow, red lamps. Highlights run along the top/left edges of metal frames; no cast shadows. Light direction is consistent in most tiles.
standout_features: Three coloured specimen tank tiles (cyan, green, red) with dark silhouettes
Octagonal hazard-striped door with nested red frames
Red chevron blast door with centre boss
Yellow safety elements (stairs handrail, ladder, railing) with strong contrast on dark wall
Drain culvert with falling cyan water
important_details: Row 1 tile 1 (observation-window): control-room glazing with slanted posts, amber lit room, seated figures at desks with monitors, one standing figure in white - recognisable
Row 1 tile 2 (lab-window-cyan): two cyan-lit window panes with white ceiling light bars, mullions, hazard strip on the sill - recognisable
Row 1 tile 3 (specimen-tank-cyan): steel-capped glass cylinder of cyan liquid with a dark humanoid silhouette and bubbles - recognisable
Row 1 tile 4 (specimen-tank-green): two yellow-green tanks with dark curled specimens, base strip of orange squares - recognisable; the specimens read as blobs more than curled forms
Row 1 tile 5 (containment-tube-red): red-lit tube with dark humanoid figure, rust-coloured collars, pipe above - recognisable
Row 1 tile 6 (bay-door-red): octagonal grey frame around a red recessed panel with vertical bars, red lamp above - recognisable
Row 2 tile 1 (hazard-door-octagon): octagonal frame with amber and black stripes, nested dark red octagons with small red lights - recognisable
Row 2 tile 2 (blast-door-diagonal): riveted square door with red and grey chevron panels split into four, centre boss - recognisable
Row 2 tile 3 (cell-bars): dark vertical bars with two crossbars, faint amber glow behind, stone-grey floor slab at bottom - recognisable
Row 2 tile 4 (cell-gate-arch): arched barred gate in a grey brick wall with dark red interior, red lamp on top - recognisable
Row 2 tile 5 (locker): left a closed grey locker with vents, handle and label; right an open locker holding an amber suit - recognisable
Row 2 tile 6 (ceiling-light-cyan): dark upper band with rivets, two white light tubes, cyan glow with hatched fade below - recognisable as a light; the lower wall reads somewhat like water
Row 3 tile 1 (terminal): console with two cyan screens above a slanted button desk and a cabinet with coloured lights - recognisable
Row 3 tile 2 (lab-tile-wall): grid of pale blue-grey tiles with grout and faint streaks - recognisable
Row 3 tile 3 (stairs-yellow): diagonal grey stair flight rising left to right with a yellow handrail - recognisable
Row 3 tile 4 (ladder-yellow): vertical yellow ladder with rungs and small wall brackets on dark wall - recognisable
Row 3 tile 5 (railing-yellow): yellow top rail, mid rail and posts above a grey toe board and riveted walkway edge - recognisable
Row 3 tile 6 (drain-culvert): arched barred opening in a riveted wall with cyan water falling from the bottom - recognisable
post_analysis.synopsis: A coherent, consistent pixel-art set of lab and prison props. Palette, outline weight and lighting style match across tiles. All 18 tiles read as their names.

findings.issue: Specimen shapes in the green tank are vague blobs rather than clearly curled creatures
findings.impact: Minor; reads as a specimen jar regardless

findings.issue: Lower half of the light tile is a cyan hatched gradient that could be read as water or a screen rather than light spill
findings.impact: Minor; the tube strip still identifies it as a light

findings.issue: Water at the bottom of the culvert ends in a scattered pixel splash at the tile edge, which will not join cleanly to a tile placed below

defect_analysis.overall: No obvious structural, perspective, floating-object or lighting defects. Only minor readability issues noted above.

mismatches_or_uncertainties: Row 1 tile 1 figures are very small; seated versus standing staff are hard to tell apart at 64 px.
Tiling behaviour (seams) was not checked; only single tiles were viewed.
The reference images named in the JSON were not compared.
